name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Pull your shoulder blades down slightly to engage your lats.
Raise your knees toward your chest by curling your pelvis up.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A hanging core exercise where you lift your knees toward your chest.

safetyNotes: Stop if you feel shoulder pain; use straps or an assisted option if your grip fails first.
